pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'le tapis' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the shop
   B. the garden
   C. the key
   D. the rug

2. What does 'un gâteau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a cake
   B. a candle
   C. a balloon
   D. a month

3. Which little word goes with 'poisson' (the fish)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. les

4. Fill in: J'ai ______ ans. (10) (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. dix
   C. six
   D. douze

5. What does 'J'ai dix doigts.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. He has short hair.
   B. I have ten fingers.
   C. She is short.
   D. I have two ears.

6. What does 'fort' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a flood
   B. strong
   C. It is cold.
   D. It is hot.

7. How do you say 'Pleased to meet you!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Salut, Kamau !
   D. Enchanté !

8. How do you say 'It is a banana.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un gâteau.
   B. Le matin, je mange du pain.
   C. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   D. C'est une banane.

9. How do you say 'the nose' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le doigt
   B. le nez
   C. la dent
   D. la jambe

10. What does 'dimanche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Thursday
   D. Sunday

11. What does 'C'est une banane.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. What is it?
   D. It is a banana.

12. What does 'merci' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Mrs, Madam
   B. thank you
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. goodbye

13. What does 'le fromage' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the orange
   B. cheese
   C. sweets
   D. the cake

14. How do you say 'the TV' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le chat
   B. la chambre
   C. le canapé
   D. la télé

15. Which spelling is correct? (1 mark)
   A. thé
   B. the
   C. thée
   D. té

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'I do not like fish.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into English: 'Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

18. Write the French words for: a flood, the wind, the storm (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'Touche ton nez !' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'Here is my family.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — the rug
   le tapis means the rug.

2. A — a cake
   un gâteau means a cake.

3. A — le
   poisson is masculine, so we say le poisson.

4. B — dix
   Dix means ten.

5. B — I have ten fingers.
   J'ai dix doigts. means I have ten fingers.

6. B — strong
   fort means strong.

7. D — Enchanté !
   Pleased to meet you! in French is Enchanté !

8. D — C'est une banane.
   It is a banana. in French is C'est une banane.

9. B — le nez
   the nose in French is le nez.

10. D — Sunday
   dimanche means Sunday.

11. D — It is a banana.
   C'est une banane. means It is a banana.

12. B — thank you
   merci means thank you.

13. B — cheese
   le fromage means cheese.

14. D — la télé
   the TV in French is la télé.

15. A — thé
   Thé has an accent aigu.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 4 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: une inondation, le vent, l'orage
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Touch your nose!
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Voici ma famille.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.
